entities.name: Query HspQ
observations: 105 aa protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q2NU66 HspQ from Sodalis glossinidius.
Predicted molecular weight 11.88 kDa, theoretical pI 4.69, and charge at pH 7 of approximately -9.1.
Contains a YccV-like Pfam domain (PF08755.17) spanning residues 5–94.

entities.name: HspQ
observations: Reviewed bacterial heat shock protein involved in degradation of certain denatured proteins, including DnaA, during heat-shock stress.
Annotated as cytoplasmic and DNA-binding in reviewed UniProt records.
Function and localization are supported by exact or high-identity reviewed homologs Q2NU66, Q1LT59, and Q8D251.

entities.name: Response to heat
observations: HspQ is annotated to GO:0009408, response to heat, in reviewed homolog records.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: HspQ is annotated to GO:0005737, cytoplasm, in reviewed homolog records.

entities.name: HspQ proteostasis role
observations: Reviewed HspQ annotations indicate participation in degradation of selected denatured proteins, including DnaA, during heat shock stress; the exact molecular mechanism and partner proteins are not established by this sequence analysis.
